title: Statistics for Data Science
blurb: Probability, exploratory analysis, sampling and the bootstrap, A/B testing done right, regression and classification from the statistical side, plus interview drills and product-analytics cases, all in Python with runnable simulations and 31 implementation problems.
sources: Bruce & Bruce, Practical Statistics for Data Scientists (O'Reilly, 2017), ch. 1-7
Kohavi, Tang & Xu, Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments (2020) - background for A/B testing pitfalls

modules.title: 0 · Probability Foundations
modules.summary: Events, conditional probability, Bayes' rule, random variables, expected value and variance.

lessons.title: Probability, conditional probability and Bayes' rule

modules.title: 1 · Exploratory Data Analysis
modules.summary: Data types, estimates of location and variability, distributions, categorical data and correlation.

lessons.title: Data types and estimates of location
Estimates of variability
Exploring distributions and categorical data
Correlation and exploring two or more variables

modules.title: 2 · Data and Sampling Distributions
modules.summary: Sampling and bias, the central limit theorem, standard errors, the bootstrap, confidence intervals and common distributions.

lessons.title: Random sampling and the many faces of bias
Sampling distributions, standard error and the central limit theorem
The bootstrap
Confidence intervals done right
Normal, t and long-tailed distributions
Binomial, Poisson and other common distributions

modules.title: 3 · Experiments and Significance Testing
modules.summary: A/B tests and permutation tests, p-values, t- and z-tests, multiple testing, ANOVA and chi-square, power, pitfalls and bandits.

lessons.title: A/B tests, hypotheses and permutation tests
Statistical significance, p-values and their misconceptions
t-tests, z-tests and degrees of freedom
Multiple testing: Bonferroni, Holm and the false discovery rate
ANOVA and the chi-square test
Power and sample size for A/B tests
A/B testing pitfalls: peeking, novelty, SRM and network effects
Multi-arm bandits: learning while earning

modules.title: 4 · Regression and Prediction
modules.summary: Simple and multiple regression, prediction intervals, factor variables, interpretation, diagnostics, splines and causality.

lessons.title: Simple linear regression and prediction intervals
Multiple regression: assessment, cross-validation and model selection
Factor variables and interpreting regression
Regression diagnostics: outliers, influence and assumptions
Polynomial regression, splines and GAMs
Correlation, causation and Simpson's paradox

modules.title: 5 · Classification
modules.summary: Naive Bayes, discriminant analysis, logistic regression, evaluation metrics and rare classes.

lessons.title: Naive Bayes and discriminant analysis
Logistic regression: odds, log-odds and maximum likelihood
Evaluating classifiers and handling rare classes

modules.title: 6 · Statistical Machine Learning
modules.summary: Bias and variance, k-NN, trees, bagging, random forests and boosting from the statistical side.

lessons.title: Statistical machine learning: k-NN, trees, bagging and boosting

modules.title: 7 · Unsupervised Learning
modules.summary: PCA, k-means, hierarchical and model-based clustering, scaling and Gower's distance.

lessons.title: Unsupervised learning: PCA and clustering, the statistical view

modules.title: 8 · Interviews and Product Cases
modules.summary: Concept drills, whiteboard calculations, probability puzzles and product-analytics case frameworks.

lessons.title: Statistics interview essentials
Product analytics case questions
